old_batch.name: Nude beach Smiltyne
old_batch.place_summary: Nude beach Smiltynė is geographically on the Curonian Spit opposite Klaipėda, reached by ferry; its Gays-Cruising page describes the male section relative to ferry approach, but these instructions may be old. 2026-05-20 municipal beach-bounds order legally defines designated women's and men's beach segments at Smiltynė I; a separate nudist segment exists. Those official categories should NOT be conflated with gay cruising; municipality warns nude sunbathing in nearby dunes outside official beach limits is prohibited and fines apply. No recent dated firsthand cruising report found.
